sources.location: deposited P1-5_Pancreas_cancer_Proteins_list.txt and P6-14_Pancreas_cancer_Proteins_list.txt (file names in files_compact.json)

claims.value: 14 PDAC patients × 4 laser-captured compartments (neoplastic parenchyma, tumour-adjacent benign exocrine parenchyma, and stroma next to each)
claims.evidence: RAW names encode patient and compartment (Patient_N_NeoplasticParenchyma/HealthyAcinar, Set_2_Patient_N_NeoStroma/HealthyStroma, PC_NN-b_NePa/HePa/NeSt/HeSt); the deposited protein lists are split P1-5 and P6-14, i.e. 14 patients

claims.value: Replicate_1/2, R1/R2 = repeat injections of one tube
Q Exactive HF-X; DDA top 20; HCD NCE 28
claims.evidence: PRIDE instrument and data processing / sample protocol
protocol alkylates with iodoacetamide; PRIDE identified PTMs include iodoacetamide derivatized residue (MOD:00397)

limitations: HCD written as MS:1000422 (beam-type collision-induced dissociation), the spec-canonical term.

INFERRED: 'Set_2_Patient_N' (stroma) is the same person as 'Patient_N' (parenchyma, set 1). Basis: 5 + 9 (PC_06–PC_14) = 14 patients, matching the deposited P1-5 / P6-14 protein lists; if Set 2 were different people the cohort would be 19.
Benign-appearing compartments are annotated disease = normal with phenotype 'tumour-adjacent…'; the donors all have PDAC.

Search settings are not stated in PRIDE and the paper is closed. Carbamidomethyl C (fixed) is annotated from the IAA alkylation and the PRIDE PTM list; PRIDE also lists carbamoylated residue (MOD:00398), but whether carbamylation or other variable modifications were searched is unknown, so none is added.
Age and sex per patient not available.
'Tube_11_HealthyAcinarHNE' (patient 1) is kept as a second benign-parenchyma source; the meaning of 'HNE' is unknown.
